name: tie_fest
provenance: Adversarial fixture A5 'Tie-fest' (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §14 A5): one fungible normal domain, budget 4, full allocation (residue must be zero), two Trials worth 5 and 5. The source states the oracle: every non-mirror pair produces 5-5 before the final tiebreak, so a final tie gate would fail. Full allocation gives exactly 5 legal allocations ((0,4),(1,3),(2,2),(3,1),(4,0)); any two distinct ones split the two equal Trials 1-1 for a 5-5 Recognition-Point tie, and mirror pairs share both Trials (10-10), so every ordered pair is a final tie. Config lives in configs/toy/tie_fest_5_5.json; oracles transcribed from the source (REQ-9.4).
